adds.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
adds.text: Hank teaches at Charles's school and runs Cerebro with him to trace the energy surge from Cairo. After Charles is taken, Hank goes to Cairo with the others to bring him back.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teaches at Charles's school and goes to Cairo to rescue him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The old friend Hank goes to Cairo to rescue.
adds.evidence: Hank is a teacher at the reopened school, picks up the Cairo energy surge and works Cerebro with Charles; the freed group flies to Cairo and rescues Xavier.

adds.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
adds.text: In Cairo, Erik turns on Apocalypse and Jean helps him tear down his armor before she burns him away. Afterwards they rebuild Charles's school together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Erik bring down Apocalypse, then rebuild the school.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Turns on Apocalypse and rebuilds the school with Jean.
adds.evidence: Jean joins Erik to dismantle Apocalypse's armor and incinerates him; 'Lehnsherr and Jean help reconstruct the school.'

adds.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
adds.text: After Alex blasts Cerebro to break Apocalypse's hold on Charles, he and Raven carry Charles out, moments before Alex dies in the explosion at the mansion.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old teammate killed in the blast at the mansion.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Helps Alex carry Charles out of Cerebro.
adds.evidence: Mystique page: 'As Raven, Moira, Hank, and Alex take the unconscious Charles out of the room', then Alex is killed in the explosion; Raven later tells Scott his brother was very brave.

adds.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
adds.text: Jean, Scott and Kurt free Hank from Stryker's base at Alkali Lake. After Apocalypse falls, Hank and Raven train Jean with the new X-Men.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Trains Jean after she frees him from Stryker.
adds.evidence: Scott, Jean and Kurt liberate McCoy, Raven, Peter and MacTaggert from Stryker; McCoy and Raven then train the recruits Scott, Jean, Ororo, Kurt and Peter.

adds.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
adds.text: Ororo turns against Apocalypse in Cairo and joins Jean and the others to bring him down. Afterwards they train together with the new X-Men.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Turns on Apocalypse and trains beside Jean.
adds.evidence: Lehnsherr and Ororo turn on En Sabah Nur alongside Scott and Jean, who incinerates him; Ororo and Jean are among the new recruits McCoy and Raven train.

adds.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
adds.text: Jean, Scott and Kurt free Peter from Stryker's base at Alkali Lake, and he fights beside them in Cairo.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Freed by Jean from Stryker's base.
adds.evidence: Stryker captures Peter with McCoy, Raven and MacTaggert; Scott, Jean and Kurt liberate them, and they go on to Cairo.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
adds.text: When Tony sends an empty suit to pull Peter out of a lake, F.R.I.D.A.Y. takes over its controls once Tony ends the call and flies it away.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scolds Peter through the empty suit, then hands it to F.R.I.D.A.Y.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Flies the empty suit away after Tony ends the call.
adds.evidence: Mark XLVII: Stark activates the suit remotely to save Parker from the lake; 'When Stark disconnected the call, F.R.I.D.A.Y. took over the suit's controls and flew away.'

adds.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
adds.text: At the Avengers compound, Pepper finds Happy with Tony and asks whether they have ruined the press conference she set up for Peter.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Asks Happy and Tony if they have ruined her press conference.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: With Tony when the press conference for Peter falls through.
adds.evidence: Pepper hurries out and asks if Stark and Happy Hogan messed up the plan; Stark then asks Hogan for the ring.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
adds.text: Tony leaves Happy to keep an eye on Peter while Happy runs the move out of Avengers Tower. At the compound, Happy hands Tony the ring he has carried since 2008.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Leaves Happy to watch over Peter.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Keeps an eye on Peter for Tony and hands him the ring.
adds.evidence: Happy is 'looking after' Peter for Stark and oversees the move from Avengers Tower; at the compound Stark asks Hogan for the ring.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
adds.text: Tony pulls Peter out of a lake and later takes back his suit after the ferry nearly sinks. After Peter stops the Vulture, Tony offers him a place in the Avengers, and Peter turns it down.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Takes back the suit, then offers Peter a place in the Avengers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Turns down Tony's offer to join the Avengers.
adds.evidence: Stark rescues Peter from the lake, confiscates the suit after the ferry, and Peter declines his invitation to join the Avengers full time.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
owner_calls.question: Scott and Erik attack Apocalypse together in Cairo (Scott's optic blasts on his shield alongside Erik's metal) but share no exchange. Add an ally stage for the joint attack, or leave it as none?
options: Add ally stage for the joint attack
owner_calls.evidence: Erik's efforts 'are soon joined by Scott (shooting at the shield with his optic blasts)'.
